title: Digital Logic
body:
Used when designing [[Digital circuit]]s

The discipline of building circuits that work on [[Discrete]] values rather than
[[Continuous]] ones. Two voltage bands stand for 0 and 1, the algebra for combining them is
[[Boolean Algebra]], and the circuits divide into two kinds:

- [[Combinational Logic]]: output is a function of the current inputs, nothing else
- [[Sequential Logic]]: feedback to the input, therefore state, therefore memory

Everything in the first half of this course is one of those two.
